items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: No except that he used to tell me little stories about the old musicians in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Well did he, was he any influence on you?

No except that he used to tell me little stories about the old musicians in New Orleans. And he used to call us, you know, like we were young, youngsters and then he'd tell us little things about the trumpet and little stories. But he never tried to show us anything, teach us anything.
Well he was quite a, he made a good bit of use of mute I think didn't he?
